versions.changelog:
- Expanded and clarified support for generational/字辈 naming, with dedicated questions and process steps for family genealogy requirements.
- Upgraded the naming process from 7 to 8 steps, adding explicit "字辈约束" (generational name constraint) analysis as the first step.
- Refined information collection: detailed prompts for generational word, its position, and handling of uncertain placement.
- Updated skill triggers to include new keywords related to generational naming (字辈、族谱、辈分) and clarified candidate scenarios.
- Changed output scoring from 6 to 7 dimensions (comprehensive score now out of 70).
- Improved interaction flow: mandatory 字辈 confirmation if mentioned, tighter questioning before naming begins.

- Improved clarity and detail in the skill description and interaction guidance.
- Enhanced information collection instructions, specifying required and optional user inputs.
- Expanded domain and knowledge system explanations for richer naming analysis.
- Refined the naming workflow steps to more clearly outline the seven-step naming method.
- Strengthened rules on name screening, including stricter avoidance of rare characters, trending names, unverifiable references, and inauspicious name patterns.
- Output and user interaction instructions are now more comprehensive, with clearer requirements for confirmation and information gathering before name generation.

- Major update: Naming process framework extracted to a separate reference file (`references/naming-framework.md`) for clarity.
- Reduced core SKILL.md file size and streamlined descriptions.
- Updated usage scope and trigger keywords for better accuracy.
- Added explicit summary of required/optional info and main interaction rules.
- Clarified that all name output and evaluation details are standardized per the external reference.
- Removed obsolete files (`README.md`, `scripts/naming_service.py`) for a cleaner project structure.
Content refined and optimized based on original naming-master-prompt.md
Refactored with official skill-creator tool for better structure and maintainability
Initial release: Complete Chinese naming system with 7-step methodology based on traditional Chinese culture and modern science
